capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Wikipedia spec table: Long Range packs 78 kWh gross / 75 kWh usable for 2021-2023 (single) and dual motor 2021-2024; InsideEVs 2024 EPA article confirms 78 kWh for the 2023 single and the 2024 dual/performance pack.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Wikipedia spec table: 75 kWh usable for the 78 kWh Long Range pack (also EV Database Volvo XC40 Recharge 78/75, same CMA pack).

chemistry.notes: Wikipedia: NMC for all Polestar 2 packs (EV Database also NMC).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: The 78 kWh Polestar 2 pack is the same CMA 108-cell NMC pack as the Volvo XC40 Recharge 78 kWh (EV Database: 400 V); the Polestar US spec page confirms 400 V for the later 82 kWh pack.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Polestar 2 manual (US, 2024): "When charging stations have been added in Google Maps, the battery will be preconditioned to reduce charging time." No manual control mentioned. The manual describes only the navigation trigger but does not state there is no manual control (the 2023 manual refers to "selecting preconditioning"), so the closest enum is used.

dc_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs (Polestar US 2024): Dual Motor 78 kWh, up to 155 kW. EV Database (European 2024 dual, 82 kWh pack) differs; North American 2024 dual kept 78 kWh per EPA/Polestar.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 11 kW per the US 2023 Polestar 2 manual; same onboard charger in 2024.

published_10_80_min.notes: InsideEVs (Polestar US 2024): Dual Motor about 34 min 10-80% at up to 155 kW.
